mapper.sql: select tmaterial.id, tmaterial.code, tmaterial.name, tmaterial.specifications, tmaterial.unit_id, tmaterial.contacts_unit_id, tmaterial.batch_flag, tmaterial.batch_attr_id, tmaterial.base_unit_id, tmaterial.same_material_flag, tmaterial.same_batch_flag, tmaterial.category_id, tmaterial.inspection_method, tmaterial.expiration_flag, tmaterial.stock_max, tmaterial.stock_min, tmaterial.expiration_date, tmaterial.rough_weight, tmaterial.net_weight, tmaterial.finance_voucher_no,tmaterial.unit_price,tmaterial.description,tmaterial.remark, tmaterial.create_by, tmaterial.create_time, tmaterial.update_by, tmaterial.update_time, tmaterial.dept_id, tmaterial.dept_name, tmaterial.del_flag, tmaterial.img from t_material tmaterial
mapper.select:
select t1.id, t1.code, t1.name, t1.specifications, t1.unit_id, t1.contacts_unit_id, t1.category_id, t1.batch_flag, t1.batch_attr_id, t1.base_unit_id, t1.same_material_flag, t1.same_batch_flag, t1.inspection_method, t1.expiration_date, t1.expiration_flag, t1.finance_voucher_no, t1.unit_price, t1.description, t1.stock_max, t1.stock_min, t1.material_length, t1.material_height, t1.material_width, t1.create_by, t1.create_time, t1.update_by, t1.update_time, t1.remark, t1.del_flag, t1.net_weight, t1.rough_weight, t1.img, t1.important_status, t2.name as unitName, t3.name as categoryName, t4.name as batch_attrName, t5.name as contactsUnitName from t_material t1 left join t_unit t2 on t1.unit_id = t2.id left join t_category t3 on t1.category_id = t3.id left join t_batch_attr t4 on t1.batch_attr_id = t4.id left join t_contacts_unit t5 on t1.contacts_unit_id = t5.id
inner join sys_user u on u.user_name = t1.create_by and u.status = '0' inner join sys_dept d on u.dept_id = d.dept_id and d.status = '0'
t1.del_flag = '0' and t1.code = #{code} and t1.name like concat('%', #{name}, '%') and t1.specifications = #{specifications} and t1.contacts_unit_id = #{contactsUnitId} and t1.category_id = #{categoryId} and t1.unit_id = #{unitId} and t1.batch_attr_id = #{batchAttrId} and t1.important_status = #{importantStatus}
${params.dataScope} order by t1.create_time desc
mapper.delete: update t_material set del_flag = '1' where id = #{id}

mapper.select: select t1.id, t1.code, t1.name, t1.specifications, t1.batch_flag, t1.batch_attr_id, t1.base_unit_id, t1.same_material_flag, t1.same_batch_flag, t1.inspection_method, t1.expiration_date, t1.expiration_flag, t1.remark, t1.del_flag, t1.net_weight, t1.rough_weight, t2.name as unitName, t3.name as categoryName, t4.name as batch_attrName, t5.name as contactsUnitName from t_material t1 left join t_unit t2 on t1.unit_id = t2.id left join t_category t3 on t1.category_id = t3.id left join t_batch_attr t4 on t1.batch_attr_id = t4.id left join t_contacts_unit t5 on t1.contacts_unit_id = t5.id where t1.del_flag = '0' and t1.code = #{code} and t1.name like concat('%', #{name}, '%') and t1.specifications = #{specifications} and t1.contacts_unit_id = #{contactsUnitId} and t1.category_id = #{categoryId} and t1.unit_id = #{unitId} and t1.batch_attr_id = #{batchAttrId} order by t1.create_time desc

select a.id, a.code, a.name, a.specifications, a.unit_id as unitId, a.contacts_unit_id as contactsUnitId, a.batch_flag as batchFlag, a.batch_attr_id as batchAttrId, a.base_unit_id as baseUnitId, a.same_material_flag as sameMaterialFlag, a.same_batch_flag as sameBatchFlag, a.category_id as categoryId, a.inspection_method as inspectionMethod, a.expiration_flag as expirationFlag, a.stock_max as stockMax, a.stock_min as stockMin, a.expiration_date as expirationDate, a.rough_weight as roughWeight, a.net_weight as netWeight, a.remark, b.name as batchAttrName from t_material a left join t_batch_attr b on a.batch_attr_id = b.id where a.id = #{id}
